happy.quote: Let us be grateful to the people who make us happy; they are the charming gardeners who make our souls blossom.
happy.author: Marcel Proust

happy.quote: Thousands of candles can be lighted from a single candle, and the life of the candle will not be shortened. Happiness never decreases by being shared.
happy.author: Buddha

happy.quote: Write it on your heart that every day is the best day in the year.
happy.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

sad.quote: There is a crack in everything. That's how the light gets in.
sad.author: Leonard Cohen

sad.quote: Promise me you'll always remember: You're braver than you believe, and stronger than you seem, and smarter than you think.
sad.author: A.A. Milne

sad.quote: You are allowed to be both a masterpiece and a work in progress simultaneously.
sad.author: Sophia Bush

demotivated.quote: Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes courage is the quiet voice at the end of the day saying, 'I will try again tomorrow.'
demotivated.author: Mary Anne Radmacher

demotivated.quote: You do not have to be good. You do not have to walk on your knees for a hundred miles through the desert repenting. You only have to let the soft animal of your body love what it loves.
demotivated.author: Mary Oliver

demotivated.quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
demotivated.author: Winston Churchill

motivated.quote: Don't ask what the world needs. Ask what makes you come alive, and go do it. Because what the world needs is people who have come alive.
motivated.author: Howard Thurman

motivated.quote: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius, power, and magic in it.
motivated.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

motivated.quote: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
motivated.author: Eleanor Roosevelt
